text.en: ControlNet is row 94 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Diffusion Model Application area.
text.zh: ControlNet 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 94 行，所属领域为“扩散模型应用”。

text.en: The annual table associates ControlNet with “Adding conditional control to text-to-image diffusion models”.
text.zh: 年度表把 ControlNet 与论文《Adding conditional control to text-to-image diffusion models》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Lvmin Zhang, Maneesh Agrawala”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Lvmin Zhang（官方页拼写）、Maneesh Agrawala（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Lvmin Zhang, Maneesh Agrawala”。
